summary: Australia (AU) localization of Business Central 29. It covers GST posting, withholding tax (WHT), Business Activity Statements (BAS), ABN and adjustment notes, EFT payments, tax invoices and credit memos, post-dated checks, address validation and cost-plus pricing. Use it for questions on Australian tax setup, posting and reporting.
overview:
The Australian layer replaces 121 W1 objects and adds 171 of its own. Most of the change is fields on W1 tables (468 in total) plus posting procedures. Tax is the core: GST with ACY amounts and full GST on prepayments; WHT with its own posting group, revenue type, posting setup and entry pages, a WHTManagement codeunit and certificate reports; and BAS setup, calculation, export and settlement. These hook into Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, Sales-Post and Purch.-Post and their invoice and prepayment helpers.

Master and document data carry ABN, ABN Division Part No., WHT posting groups, adjustment note fields (Adjustment, BAS Adjustment, Adjustment Applies-to) and tax document flags. The banking side adds EFT setup, an EFT register, EFT file creation and post-dated checks. Other additions are address and AMAS validation with bar codes, posted tax invoice and credit memo pages and reports, and cost-plus pricing fields.

Learn documents this under "Australia local functionality": Australian Tax overview, Withholding Tax, ABN and adjustment notes, GST posting and prepayments, BAS business units, EFT, addresses, e-invoicing with Peppol PINT A-NZ, and Payment Times Reporting.
key_points: GST: Enable GST (Australia) in General Ledger Setup, ACY amount fields on lines and buffers, full GST on prepayments, GST sales and purchase entry pages, and a Calculate GST Settlement report.

WHT: WHT business and product posting groups, WHT posting setup, revenue types and WHT entries, with settlement and certificate reports. Learn says vendors without an ABN get WHT calculated automatically from the WHT posting setup.
BAS: BAS setup, calculation sheet, business units (lodged as a group), BAS export and BAS fields on G/L, VAT and VAT report tables.
ABN and adjustment notes: ABN fields on company, customer, vendor and contact; Adjustment, BAS Adjustment and Adjustment Applies-to on documents and ledgers; Adjustment Mandatory setting.
EFT: bank account and vendor bank EFT fields, EFT Management codeunit, EFT Register and the Create EFT File and Transfer EFT Register reports.
Posted tax invoice and tax credit memo pages and reports for sales and purchases, with dedicated number series in the sales and purchases setup.
Address validation with AMAS and DPID bar codes; cost-plus pricing fields on price lines; post-dated checks.
Extensibility: events such as OnBeforePostWHT, OnBeforeUpdateCostPlusPrices and OnAfterSetDefaultCancelReasonCode, plus GST and WHT procedures on posting codeunits.

areas.what: Adds GST, WHT and BAS handling to general ledger posting. New objects include ABN Management, BAS Management, WHT Management, BAS pages, WHT pages, GST entry pages and tax invoice codeunits. W1 tables gain BAS, adjustment and settlement fields, and Gen. Jnl.-Post Line gains WHT and GST procedures and events.
areas.why: Learn describes GST and WHT setup, posting, settlement and BAS reporting to the ATO as the Australian tax requirements.

areas.what: Adds ABN, WHT groups, adjustment note fields, tax document tracking and ACY amounts to purchase documents, lines and vendors. Posting codeunits gain GST, WHT, prepayment and vendor exchange rate ACY procedures. Purchases setup gets GST groups, WHT and tax invoice number series.
areas.why: Learn explains ABNs, adjustment notes and WHT on vendors without an ABN.

areas.what: Adds WHT groups, adjustment notes, sales tax exemption fields, tax document types and ACY amounts to sales documents and customers. Sales-Post and prepayment codeunits get GST and WHT procedures. Own objects include the AU/NZ Statement report.
areas.why: Learn covers GST on prepayments, adjustment notes and posted tax invoices and credit memos.

areas.what: Adds ABN, WHT registration and tax period fields to Company Information, address validation with AMAS and a County table. Format Address gets bar code and tax invoice address procedures, and DateFilter-Calc gets period checks.
areas.why: Learn describes Australian addresses with DPID bar codes and AMAS validation.

areas.what: Adds EFT payments with a register, file creation and bank BSB fields. Adds post-dated check fields on bank ledger entries, WHT in bank reconciliation posting, plus reports for reconciliation, deposit slips, cash flow comparison and back-dated aging.
areas.why: Learn documents EFT vendor payments, bank reconciliation, deposit slip and cash flow comparison reports.

areas.what: Adds a WHT Product Posting Group to items, templates and item charges. Adds vendor exchange rate ACY on item journal lines, cost-plus price updating in ItemCostManagement, and the Stock Card and Stock Movement reports.
Adds the BAS Export codeunit, which produces the BAS export file, and the G/L-BAS permission set. A source code table extension supports local source codes.
areas.why: Learn describes BAS reporting to the ATO.

areas.what: Adds bar code management with the BarCode Checking and BarCode Batch Job reports, used for address bar codes.
areas.why: Learn describes DPID bar code printing for Australian addresses.

areas.what: Adds Published Price, Cost, Cost-plus % and Discount Amount to price list lines and worksheet lines, with procedures to update the unit price from the cost-plus percentage.
areas.why: Learn has a page on determining sales price by cost plus percentage.

areas.what: Changes the LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets for the Australian objects.
Adds a service document management codeunit for APAC and a Service Manager role center page extension.
Adds ABN, Registered, ABN Division Part No. and IRD No. fields to Contact.
areas.why: Learn says ABNs are entered on company, customer, vendor and contact cards.

areas.what: Adds the Expense Event Subscriber AU codeunit for Australian expense handling.
Adds a WHT Product Posting Group field to Fixed Asset.
Data Migration Facade Helper gets a procedure that creates a county when needed.
Pre-map Incoming Purch. Doc can find a vendor by ABN and has a new event after incoming document header data is set.
Adds a WHT Product Posting Group field to Resource.

issues: Key point 2 says foreign vendors get WHT calculated automatically. The input only says vendors without an ABN get WHT calculated automatically. The Foreign Vend field is listed as a feature, but nothing says what it does.

The overview says WHT has 'its own tables'. No WHT tables appear in the listed own objects; the input shows only WHT pages (posting groups, revenue types, posting setup, entries), the WHTManagement codeunit and the certificate and settlement reports. Reworded to match.
Small point: the added reports include objects named for other APAC countries (WHT PND, TH copies, Monthly VAT Declaration). The narrative does not mention them, and it does not have to.
